item.title: EP71 突发！美国侵略委内瑞拉的来龙去脉
item.description:
本期概要：

本期我们讨论了特朗普政府针对委内瑞拉的军事行动及背后的战略意图。在军事实力相对较弱的背景下，特朗普政府试图通过军事干预实现政策目标，包括直接军事行动和控制委内瑞拉的油田与矿产资源。其门罗主义政策明显，行动嚣张，特别是在中国代表团访问委内瑞拉期间发动袭击，显示了对委内瑞拉政权的直接意图。

特朗普政府还通过在拉美地区部署军事力量和施加经济政治压力，意图迫使政权更迭以控制能源资源。同时，特朗普政府在拉美的总体策略包括支持右翼政权，以应对中国的经济和政治影响，尽管中国通过一带一路项目在拉美推动了实质发展。最后，推荐了一款敦煌日历作为新年礼物，体现了文化传承和对美好未来的期待。这段对话反映了特朗普政府对拉美的强硬政策及其对中美在拉美地区竞争的影响。

item.title: EP70 中马关系将迈向新台阶，开启新的黄金50年
item.description:
Summary:

It celebrates fifty years of diplomatic relations between China and Malaysia, initiated in 1974, marking Malaysia as the first ASEAN nation to establish ties with China. It highlights the historical depth of their connection, dating back centuries through trade and cultural exchange, including the notable voyages of Zheng He and the migration of Chinese to Malaysia. Furthermore, the significant contributions of Malaysian Chinese to preserving Chinese culture through education and innovative art forms, while also acknowledging their support for China during challenging periods. We conclude by looking towards a future of strengthened ties and cooperation, particularly within the framework of the Belt and Road Initiative and the development of the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone.

item.title: EP69 全球关税压力下，敦煌网却一夜之间爆火美国
item.description:
Summary:

Recent surges in popularity for Chinese e-commerce platforms like DHgate and Temu in the US market are attributed to viral marketing on TikTok, highlighting direct-from-factory sales of often unbranded or generic versions of popular goods. DHgate, a long-established B2B platform, experienced a massive increase in US downloads, even topping shopping app charts. 

This trend reflects a growing American consumer interest in affordable goods, potentially driven by economic anxieties and a desire to bypass traditional retail markups. However, this influx of Chinese e-commerce faces increasing scrutiny and potential countermeasures from the US government, including stricter customs checks and the possible elimination of the de minimis import exemption, which could significantly impact prices and logistics.

item.title: EP68 美团和京东，正在成为彼此的“眼中钉”
item.description:
Summary:

Recent commentary and strategic moves indicate a burgeoning rivalry between Meituan and JD, particularly in instant retail and food delivery. Meituan's CEO publicly downplayed JD's entry into the food delivery market, highlighting Meituan's existing dominance in non-food instant retail. At the same time, JD, led by Richard Liu, emphasized social value and fair treatment of riders. 

JD's approach involves significant subsidies and a focus on higher-quality, chain restaurant partnerships, contrasting with Meituan's vast network and lower-cost model. This competition reflects a broader shift towards instant fulfillment and a battle for consumer mindshare, with various companies vying for a piece of this expanding market.

item.title: EP66 AI大战一触即发！谷歌已经发力！OpenAI动作真的太慢了
item.description:
Summary:
Google is strategically advancing in the AI race by prioritizing open collaboration and ecosystem building, contrasting with what the author perceives as OpenAI's slower, more closed-off approach. Google's recent moves include keeping some research private, launching its advanced Gemini 2.5 model with broad free access, and introducing the A2A communication protocol for AI agents, aiming to foster interoperability across different AI systems. 

The AI landscape is shifting from focusing on individual large models to a network of collaborating AI agents, akin to the transition from early steam engines to the widespread impact of interconnected machinery during the industrial revolution. This suggests that OpenAI's reliance on a closed ecosystem centered around its technology may hinder its future competitiveness as the industry moves toward open standards and collaborative AI solutions. The emergence of standards like Google's A2A and Anthropic's MCP indicates a trend where the ability for AI systems to work together will be crucial, potentially diminishing the dominance of any single AI model or platform.

item.title: EP65 在美国造 iPhone，根本不现实
item.description:
Summary:

The feasibility of manufacturing iPhones in the United States, as suggested by some American leaders. It highlights the immense and intricate global supply chain Apple has established over decades, emphasizing China's crucial role in raw material refinement, component production, and assembly. 

We argues that the US lacks the necessary resources, skilled labor, and established infrastructure to replicate this complex ecosystem efficiently and cost-effectively. Furthermore, the significantly higher labor costs and potential tariffs on imported components would likely make a US-made iPhone prohibitively expensive. The piece concludes by suggesting that forcing manufacturing back to the US could harm Apple's profitability and innovation, referencing a failed attempt by another American company to produce a phone domestically.

item.title: EP64 “黑色星期一”来了，全球股市巨震！
item.description:
Summary:

Fueled by fears of escalating tariffs announced by the Trump administration, global financial markets experienced a significant downturn resembling the "Black Monday" crash of 1987. This triggered a massive sell-off in U.S. stocks, with major indices like the S&P 500 and Nasdaq witnessing substantial losses and entering correction or bear market territory. 

Asian markets also plummeted, and commodities such as oil and copper sharply declined as investors sought safe-haven assets. Market commentators and analysts expressed deep concern about a potential recession, drawing parallels to historical market collapses. Despite the widespread alarm in financial circles, the Trump administration remained seemingly unconcerned, downplaying the market volatility and asserting confidence in the economic outlook. The uncertainty surrounding the final tariff policies has created anxiety among businesses and investors, hindering planning and raising fears of a looming economic downturn.

item.title: EP63 尹锡悦被罢免，韩国将走向何方？

The implications of President Yoon Suk-yeol's potential impeachment in South Korea, linking it to a critical juncture for the country's political system established in 1987. It argues that this presents a window for constitutional reform, spearheaded by political strategist Kim Jong-in, to address long-standing issues of political instability and executive-legislative gridlock. item.title: EP61 太离谱！全世界都在吃的大瓜：美国军事计划竟泄密
item.description:
Summary:

An American military plan to strike Yemen was inadvertently disclosed when a national security aide mistakenly added The Atlantic editor-in-chief Jeffrey Goldberg to a Signal messaging group seemingly comprised of high-ranking Trump administration officials. Goldberg witnessed discussions and received detailed information about the impending operation, including target specifics and timelines. 

Concerns about the mission's rationale and potential economic repercussions were voiced within the group by individuals appearing to be Vice President Pence and others. Following the actual airstrike, group members exchanged celebratory messages and damage assessments, confirming the legitimacy of the leak. While President Trump claimed ignorance, the White House initiated an investigation, downplaying the incident and expressing continued trust in the national security team, as Democrats called for congressional scrutiny.

item.title: EP60 OpenAI到底怎么了？居然建议美国政府禁止开源模型DeepSeek
item.description:
Summary:

We outline a proposal by OpenAI to the US government advocating for stricter regulations and export controls on Chinese AI technology, specifically naming DeepSeek, an open-source model. The author argues that OpenAI's recommendations, framed as security concerns, stem from anxiety over the increasing capabilities of open-source models like DeepSeek, which threaten OpenAI's closed-source dominance and lucrative partnerships, particularly with Microsoft. 

The rise of DeepSeek and its cost-effectiveness are causing major tech companies to re-evaluate their dependence on OpenAI, potentially leading to a decoupling of cloud services and large language model providers. The piece concludes that OpenAI should focus on technological advancement and business model innovation rather than political maneuvering to maintain its competitive edge.

item.title: EP59 巴拿马运河，绝不能就这么卖了
item.description:
Summary:

The controversial sale of 43 global port assets, including key terminals at both ends of the Panama Canal, by Hong Kong businessman Lee Ka-Shing to a BlackRock-led consortium in March 2025. This transaction has ignited significant concern and criticism from Chinese state media and officials, who view it not merely as a business deal but as potentially aligning with a US strategy to undermine China's maritime power. 

This sale could be interpreted as a lack of patriotism and a failure to consider China's strategic interests amid escalating geopolitical tensions, particularly in light of perceived US efforts to control global shipping routes. The author argues that Lee Ka-Shing missed an opportunity to leverage China's influence to potentially block or negotiate the sale in a way that better protected national interests, contrasting his actions with instances where Chinese entities facing foreign pressure received state support. 

Ultimately, the sale was a strategic misstep with broader implications for China's economic security in the face of perceived US economic warfare.

item.title: EP57 特朗普要正式搞垮欧盟
item.description:
Summary:

American sources reveal a Republican think tank, the Heritage Foundation, held a closed-door meeting in March 2025 to discuss dismantling the European Union, reflecting Donald Trump's hostile stance towards the bloc. Their strategy, outlined in a report titled "The Great Reset," proposes disbanding the European Commission, fundamentally reforming the European Court of Justice, and significantly weakening the European Parliament, aiming to return power to individual member states. This initiative stems from a belief that a powerful, unified EU challenges American interests by becoming a significant geopolitical and economic competitor. The report suggests renaming a reformed entity the "European Community of Nations," effectively reducing the EU's centralized authority and potentially hindering its growing power in areas like defense and finance, a trend the US views unfavorably.
